title: uid/route mismatch has no detection: add doctor check + launch-time refuse-on-mismatch
description: omf-nv9 GATE (critic BLOCKING #2). dispatch/README.md:5 calls the OS account the HARD boundary, but nothing in the tree compares the effective uid / os.UserHomeDir() against the requested route (no os.Getuid anywhere). 'omf <work-profile>' launched from the private login resolves HOME=work yet runs as the private uid and can read private files by absolute path. The commits spend large machinery on the disclaimed defense-in-depth env layer while the 'hard' boundary gets no enforcement OR detection. FIX (narrow, reviewed): (1) omf doctor check -- warn if os.UserHomeDir() does not match the account each routed profile would resolve; (2) launch-time guard in router -- refuse (or loud warn) when the current login home != the requested route's home, so a cross-account launch fails closed instead of silently mis-running. Do NOT add uid-switching (SysProcAttr.Credential) without separate review -- detection first. forge gates the diff.
notes: Committed 67a19fe Refuse cross-account routed launches. Router now refuses routed launches when current login HOME does not match the compiled route HOME; doctor surfaces route-home mismatches as warnings and validates profiles without uid switching. Verified RED targeted failures, targeted green, full go test/vet, and just ci.

title: GATE-BLOCKER: KindCopilot is credential-bearing but escapes requiresAccountRouting -> unrouted ambient HOME
description: omf-nv9 GATE consensus finding (security-reviewer MEDIUM-1 + critic BLOCKING #1). manifest.go:25 defines KindCopilot and validKind accepts it (manifest.go:261), but requiresAccountRouting (manifest.go:270-271) lists only claude/codex/gemini/forge/omc/omx. A backend kind=copilot routing=none PASSES Validate() and runs unrouted: buildEnv sees routed=false (account.go) -> no HOME pin, no name-allowlist, no value-scrubbing -> child inherits ambient $HOME + any env_allowlist var verbatim. GitHub Copilot stores OAuth tokens under ~/.config/github-copilot, so this is the exact credential-fallthrough omf-egk claims to close. ROBUST FIX (do BOTH): (1) add KindCopilot to requiresAccountRouting; (2) defense-in-depth: in router buildEnv, if !routed && requiresAccountRouting(backend.Kind) return a SecurityError (fail-closed re-check independent of parse-time Validate -- security-reviewer MEDIUM-2). CONSIDER critic's stronger variant: invert default so unknown/new kinds REQUIRE routing and only an explicit safe-set (vendor, local-llm) may opt out -- prevents every future kind re-opening this hole. Add tests: copilot+routing=none rejected by Validate; buildEnv refuses an unrouted credential kind. GATE omf-nv9 STAYS OPEN until this closes + forge re-verifies.
notes: Committed 999cca2 Refuse unrouted Copilot credential backends. Added Copilot to fail-closed routing-required semantics via manifest.RequiresAccountRouting, added router buildEnv defense-in-depth SecurityError for unrouted credential kinds, and regression tests for Parse and buildEnv. Verified RED targeted failure, targeted green, full go test/vet, and just ci.

title: OMC review -> dispatch: no HTTP timeout + local-llm -p misroute + budget no-op (3 HIGH, fix-first) + 3 MED
description:
Independent OMC code review (opus) of omf/dispatch. SOLID confirmed: slice-aliasing handled everywhere (append([]string(nil),..) before extra), response bodies drained+closed, flock single-flight test real, -p off-by-one correct for non-llm paths, routing invariant tests strong.

FINDINGS (omx lane):
[HIGH] llm/service.go:50-54 + app.go:79 -- NO HTTP timeout anywhere. NewClient falls back to http.DefaultClient (no timeout); runLLM uses context.Background() with no deadline. A hung/slow llama-swap(:8080)/ollama(:11434) -- exactly the heavy-MLX-load failure mode -- makes omf llm list/load/unload block forever. Fix: default &http.Client{Timeout: 30s} when cfg.HTTPClient==nil, and context.WithTimeout in runLLM (generous bounded deadline for load warmup).
[HIGH] router.go:54-62 -- local-llm branch returns BEFORE the -p check and builds argv from Interactive only (never Oneshot). `omf <llm> -p "..."` appends -p to the INTERACTIVE argv under ModeSupervisor instead of using oneshot; and no empty-Interactive guard (the non-llm path at :77 has one). Untested -- thats how it slipped. Fix: route local-llm through the same -p/empty-Interactive checks, or explicitly reject -p+empty Interactive with UsageError. Add a test for `omf <llm-profile> -p`.
[HIGH] llm/service.go:104-145 -- Load budget check is a no-op for any model not in budgetsGiB. app.go llmClient() builds NewClient(Config{}) with nil BudgetsGiB -> empty map -> checkBudget returns nil for every real-CLI model. The DefaultMaxGiB=14 cap + BudgetError are dead code outside tests; admission preflight is NOT enforced by the Go loader for unbudgeted models. Fix: look up SizeBytes from List/api-show and compare to maxGiB, or document+surface that enforcement needs explicit BudgetsGiB (currently ships none). RULE-0: reads as enforced but isnt.
[MED] manifest.go:193-200 -- no duplicate-backend-name rejection; findBackend returns first match, second silently shadowed. Add seen-map + error.
[MED] app.go:158-160 -- defaultManifestPath returns relative "../omf.toml" (CWD-relative). Run omf from elsewhere -> wrong/no manifest. Resolve against FORGE_CONFIG/XDG/exec-dir; make absolute.
[MED] manifest.go:283-333 -- hand-rolled TOML array parser accepts only single-line ["a","b"]; multi-line TOML arrays (valid, any writer emits) fail. Diverges from the authoritative Rust serde parser. Add a round-trip test feeding the same omf.toml fixture to both Rust Parse and Go Parse asserting identical resolution.
[OPEN/verify] llm/service.go:104-118 -- Load warmup posts max_tokens:1 to /v1/chat/completions. Does llama-swap actually load+PIN the model on a chat call, or only on real inference? If lazy, load reports success while model is not resident (RULE-0 false-confirm). Needs a live :8080 check.
Verdict: FIX-FIRST on the 3 HIGHs (all reachable from main; none hard). Full transcript on request.
notes: Fixed all HIGHs: default HTTP timeout + bounded runLLM context; unbudgeted Load now discovers SizeBytes and refuses over DefaultMaxGiB while admitting fits; local-llm -p uses oneshot template and empty interactive returns usage. Also fixed duplicate backend-name rejection. Deferred MED-only items: absolute default manifest path and multi-line TOML array support.

A real same-uid-resistant boundary (uid+perms via os/user.Current or os.Getuid table) is a SEPARATE reviewed change, not this -- track so the SecurityError label is not mistaken for that work being done.
notes: Committed 15646ce Frame route-home guard as HOME accident prevention. title: OMC review -> omf-nv9: work!=private config-redirect env gap + Go/Rust manifest asymmetry + 5 secrets/guard hardening
description:
Independent OMC security+code review (2 reviewers, opus) of the work!=private floor. Input for the omf-nv9 routing-invariant gate. SOLID confirmed: argv-arrays (no shell/eval), compiled literal route table beats hostile caller HOME/FORGE_CONFIG (well-tested), routing=none strips HOME/FORGE_CONFIG, work-vault refused for private routes, keychain hands-off read-only, no plaintext fallback, zeroize on the primary path, clamp direction correct+symmetric (Go <=floor == Rust >floor).

FINDINGS (forge lane):
[HIGH] account.go:100-122 buildEnv -- work!=private isolation only manages HOME+FORGE_CONFIG. Every OTHER allowlisted env var is passed through VERBATIM from the ambient shell, even for work/private routed backends. A child honoring XDG_CONFIG_HOME / GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL / GH_CONFIG_DIR / GNUPGHOME / CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR / npm_config_userconfig etc. can resolve the PRIVATE config tree while HOME is correctly clamped to work. Both reviewers flagged independently. Shipped omf.toml does not allowlist these (so not currently triggered) but the floor does not defend it. Fix: for routed backends, deny-by-default the known config-redirect names (or derive them from the resolved account), + a test. THIS IS THE CORE-GUARANTEE GAP for omf-nv9.
[HIGH] manifest.rs:79 vs manifest.go:177 -- asymmetry: Go parser REJECTS HOME/FORGE_CONFIG in env_allowlist; Rust parser has NO such guard. The shipped omf.toml lists HOME in env_allowlist -> rejected by Go, accepted by Rust. The two floors are not mirrors. Fix: add validate() to Rust mirroring Go; drop HOME from omf.toml:24,34 (it is injected automatically).
[MED] execute.go:66-69 envList fails OPEN: env==nil returns os.Environ() (full ambient env). Currently unreachable (buildEnv always non-nil) but a fail-open default in the exec path. Fix: nil -> empty slice, never os.Environ().
[MED] secrets.rs:175 op resolved via PATH (bare "op") while keychain pins /usr/bin/security. A planted op on PATH intercepts every private-vault read. Pin /opt/homebrew/bin/op or scrub PATH.
[MED] secrets.rs:173-186 op_read reference unvalidated -- argv injection prevented (array) but op-flag injection possible. Validate reference.starts_with("op://") and pass -- before it.
[MED] secrets.rs:271 cmd_env write! errors swallowed (let _ =) -> partial secret emit reported as exit OK (RULE-0). Propagate + ERR.
[MED] guard.rs:87 flock match EWOULDBLOCK only; add EAGAIN for portability.
[LOW] secrets.rs op_read raw out.stdout Vec<u8> not zeroized on non-UTF8 error path.
Full reviewer transcripts available on request.
notes: Fixed Go remainder: routed work/private backends strip config/identity redirect env names while routing=none remains transparent; envList(nil) now fails closed to empty environment. Rust/core items were handled by forge per handoff.
